Chapter 6419: Crumbling

Chapter 6419: Crumbling

“Monarch, this is so bad, the island is crumbling!” Black Wind Monarch’s subordinate panicked.

“Then stop standing there, gather your stuff and run!” Black Wind himself was ready to evacuate.

“To where?” the subordinate asked.

“Who cares, just leave this place first! Tell everyone!” Black Wind slapped him.

The subordinate calmed down and leaped outside: “Brothers, evacuate, run!”

Similar chaos occurred on Yin-yang Island. The young men and women didn’t know where to hide and trembled with fear.

“Young ones, board the ship!” Fortunately, the couple had prepared a ship to evacuate them.

“Your Majesty, what should we do?” An expert asked Goldblade Emperor: “Do we proceed with our plan?”

“No, all of you must leave now.” Goldblade shouted.

“To where?” His followers were confused.

“The sky’s the limit. We will meet again if it’s meant to be. Go!” Goldblade shouted.

“Your Majesty! We wish to follow you to the bitter end!” They kneeled on the ground.

“What bitter end? Stop jinxing me, just keep on living well.” Goldblade said: “Leave or you will find out how sharp my blade is.”

The followers exchanged glances before bowing their head.

“Your Majesty, please take care.” They didn’t know what he wanted to do but it must be dangerous.

Once they left, Goldblade raised his saber and stared at the crumbling islands: “Not going to be a bandit today, it’s been a long time since I’ve done something like this, my blade eagers.”

As for Soaring Peak, it rotated and released waves of light to maintain structural rigidity.

“Everyone should have an opportunity.” Luosha Devil Emperor understood Li Qiye’s comment at this point.

“Raa!” A stench of death engulfed the falling isles and rotted weaker inhabitants.

This naturally came from the massive Nine-cries Emperor.

Villains became afraid and tried to run, not wanting to be caught by the aura descending from the wings.

“Whoosh!”A golden slash cut a path through the aura, brimming with powerful heroism.

“Goldblade Emperor!” Everyone recognized the technique.

Goldblade leaped into the air and fused his blade with his grand dao.

“Run!” Black Wind, the yin-yang couple, and others immediately fled through the gap.

“You want to die, Goldblade?” Nine-cries was furious.

“Not quite, let’s have some fun.” Goldblade floated in the air and was in high spirits.

“Is it time?” A youth stepped out from an island, looking feeble and pale. His eyes seemed to be blocked by something so he kept it close.

His strange aura was suffocating and madness-inducing.

“Ghost-sparrow, coming out to play?” Goldblade said.

Ghost-sparrow ranked fifth among the nine villains - a powerful desolate god at the stately stage.

He came from a noble family but came across a yin fortune. It attached to him and could ignite someone’s greed and desires until they go crazy and die.

Because of this, he accidentally harmed many of his clan’s members. His fiancee came to break off the engagement at the wrong time, causing him to fall into madness and open his eyes.

This fully released the spell and burned all of his and his fiancee’s clan. As he ran away, he burned another ten kingdoms and their inhabitants.

This only stopped with Desolate Frontier’s involvement, forcing him to hide in Sea of Heavenly Sin.

“Goldblade, stop trying to be a hero.” Ghost-sparrow’s aura caused the air to twist with his breath.

“It’s fine, you’re too insane to see how great I am.” Goldblade laughed.

“You’re the insane one!” Ghost-sparrow opened his eyes and released an inferno.

It didn’t burn anyone directly, only illuminating their soul and heart. Desires surged uncontrollably - whether one wanted to be an immortal or the richest man. Those affected would become overwhelmed with excitement as if their dreams were within reach.
